text: Generic graph capability implemented and shared with DirectedRoutes; graph algorithms23 JVM/23 JS/23 Native pass, including independent Floyd-Warshall and owner compile refusals. New mesh adapter preserves exact domains and accepts zero/non-intrinsic custom graph costs. Root private Dijkstra and per-source adjacency removed; graph snapshot prepared once per matrix. Added primitive infinity readers so Root does not allocate Some per target. Preparing pin-only neuroim/neuroatlas descendants in separate clones (old atlas7cfe136 remains untouched), needed for one graph4s revision across all default dependencies. No provider publication yet. Final graph613371f, neuroim6d20f52 and atlas7a66219; mesh final gate and producer scope laws running before Root qualification.
